description: Convert a Word (.doc, .docx, .odt), PowerPoint (.ppt, .pptx) or Excel (.xls, .xlsx) document to PDF with LibreOffice, keeping fonts, tables, images and page layout; each slide or sheet becomes one or more pages. Use this to turn an Office file into a fixed, shareable PDF, not for files that are already PDFs. Large presentations can take 30 seconds or more. Password-protected Office files are not supported. The input is uploaded to the Papyrio API, processed in memory and not stored. The result is written to output_path, replacing any file already there, and the call returns that path and the size in bytes. Inputs are limited to 50 MB, and each call counts as one operation against the daily quota.

file.description: Absolute path to the Office document. The extension decides how it is read, so it must be one of .doc, .docx, .odt, .ppt, .pptx, .xls or .xlsx.

output_path.description: Absolute path to write the result to. Defaults to the input file with a "-papyrio.pdf" suffix.

name: office_to_pdf
